$comment: Per-shot settings for tools/photo/clean_lightbox.py. Coordinates are pixels in the oriented original. F01 GCD detail (A6): the right temple at the hinge, close, from the front right. The engraved wordmark and old emblem come off stroke by stroke. The temple's face is seen nearly straight on here (the old print's block is 2.7 times as long as it is tall, as on the side view IMG_3579), so the GCD is barely foreshortened.

lenses.name: far lens (wearer's left), cut by the edge

marks.name: engraved wordmark and old emblem, near temple (inset from the temple's edges, which the stroke detector would otherwise take for strokes)
